description: A React-like component named IconButton built with Lightning.js framework. It renders a customizable icon button with styling, hover, and focus feedback, and includes methods for click interaction and focus control.

classes.name: IconButton
classes.description: A small rounded icon button component with custom theming, hover and focus effects.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Public method that emits an 'icon-click' event upward with a reference to itself.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Sets the focus state to true to indicate the button is focused.

methods.name: unfocus
methods.description: Sets the focus state to false to indicate the button is no longer focused.
